contradictions.description: The 2026-06-30 AP aging totals $22,749.53, while the trial balance reports Accounts Payable of $45,577.93, a $22,828.40 difference. The GL shows this difference as the unpaid remainder of opening payables, but it is absent from the dated AP aging.

w26-accrual_schedule.reason: The May prepaid schedule and insurance contract uniquely support the June opening balance, $184 monthly amortization, closing balance, and missing journal entry.

w26-bank_rec.reason: The bank statement, cash GL, and trial balance provide sufficient information to identify outstanding checks, the deposit in transit, and two unrecorded bank fees and to reconcile both sides uniquely.

w26-journal_entries.reason: The checklist, GL, payroll register, prepaid support, fixed-asset register, and vendor bills establish which June entries are missing and which bill codings require reclassification.

w26-variance_analysis.reason: June activity can be isolated from the GL and adjusted for the supported close entries before comparison with the June budget; selection of material gaps can be made using ordinary professional judgment.
